description: Resolve exactly who a campaign will reach. Returns the targeting kind, resolved list and segment names (flagging references that no longer exist), filter conditions, individual include/exclude adjustments, a plain-language summary, and a live recipient count. Critically, it reports whether targeting is unset - an unset campaign falls back to every active subscriber when scheduled. Use this to verify a scheduled campaign's audience before it sends. This is a read-only resolved view, not the write shape: to change targeting, pass `targetLists` (e.g. {type:'lists', listIds:['list_123']}) or the `segmentId`/`listIds` shorthands to update_campaign or schedule_campaign.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: get_campaign_audience

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_campaign_audience` MCP tool.

audience.description: Resolved targeting: `type`, a plain-language `summary`, `isUnset` (true when scheduling would fall back to every active subscriber), resolved `lists` and `segments` with names and a `missing` flag, `filters`, `include`/`exclude` rules, and individual subscriber adjustments.

campaignId.description: Campaign the audience was resolved for.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

recipientCount.description: Number of subscribers matching the effective targeting right now.

targetLists.description: Raw stored targeting exactly as persisted on the campaign. Null when targeting has never been set.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
